# @dxtmisha/demo

> Interactive sandbox application and playground for DXT UI components and SSR rendering.

Demonstrates real-world usage of `@dxtmisha/d1`, `@dxtmisha/functional`, and `@dxtmisha/nitro-basic` in both client-side and server-side rendering modes.

## Key Modules & Files

- [App.vue](src/App.vue): Root Vue application component.
- [router.ts](src/router.ts): Client and SSR application routes for component playgrounds.
- [entry-client.ts](src/entry-client.ts): Client hydration entry point using `nitro-basic`.
- [entry-server.ts](src/entry-server.ts): Nitro SSR server entry point.
- [pages](src/pages): Interactive demo pages showcasing DXT UI components and layout systems.
- [templates](src/templates): HTML document templates for SSR rendering.

## Optional

- [package.json](package.json): Scripts for running the dev server and building the demo.
